mentions.name: Topicle
mentions.description: A Reddit alternative social platform featuring public moderation logs, visible poster countries, and more transparent moderation. It is physically based in Australia to add geographical diversity to the social media landscape, and is available as an Android app and on the web.
mentions.problem: Existing social media platforms have opaque moderation and limited geographical diversity.
mentions.audience: Explicitly a broad consumer social platform with 1300+ users.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a Reddit alternative called Topicle with public mod logs, visible poster countries and more transparent moderation. It's also physically based in Australia, which adds a bit of geographical diversity to the social media landscape.
mentions.author: deminature
